name: 84066 · Roosevelt, UT
findings: ZIP 84066 (Roosevelt) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84066 (Roosevelt) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
64% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
